„Das Moor bewahrt keinen ordentlichen In: “The moor keeps no proper index. That's no reason for you to invent one.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“The moor keeps no proper index. That's no reason for you to invent one.” “The test is called The Name in the Wrong Peat. You'll find it at the Lime Market. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
„Die letzte Probe braucht keine neue Sch: “The final test needs no new debt,” says Hedda. “In the dining car lie your copy and a counter-record. Decide how others can still recognise your mistake later.”
„Ein Faden hält auch mit einer Lücke. Nu: “A thread holds even with a gap. Only a noose has to pull everything tight.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“A thread holds even with a gap. Only a noose has to pull everything tight.” “The test is called The Seam Between Two Times. You'll find it at the Old Wages Office. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
„Ein Schlüssel ist kein Eigentumsnachwei: “A key is no proof of ownership. A very polite burglar once had to explain that to me.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“A key is no proof of ownership. A very polite burglar once had to explain that to me.” “The test is called The Door Without a Pledge. You'll find it at the Terminus. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
„Eine Rolle kann eine Tür öffnen. Wohnen: “A role can open a door. You should still live in your own face.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“A role can open a door. You should still live in your own face.” “The test is called The Coat of Objection. You'll find it at the The Last Shift tea room. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
„Ich habe einmal eine ganze Schicht getr: “I once carried a whole shift. Afterwards nobody could stand without asking me.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“I once carried a whole shift. Afterwards nobody could stand without asking me.” “The test is called The Load on Two Shoulders. You'll find it at the Quarry Steps. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
„Ich sah früher Fehler überall, nur nich: “I used to see faults everywhere, except in my own assessments. Your lantern should shine behind you too.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“I used to see faults everywhere, except in my own assessments. Your lantern should shine behind you too.” “The test is called The Light Under the Varnish. You'll find it at the Lime Market. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
„Ich war auf der Waage. Bei Sequenz vier: “I was on the Scale. At Sequence 4 I noticed I was already weighing every kindness as an advance. That's when I stopped.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“I was on the Scale. At Sequence 4 I noticed I was already weighing every kindness as an advance. That's when I stopped.” “The test is called The Double Claim. You'll find it at the Old Wages Office. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
„Pfad der Waage, Sequenz vier. Irgendwan: “Pathway of the Scale, Sequence 4. At some point I was weighing even a kind word against an old debt. I laid down the office, not my responsibility.” She strokes a bare lever. “Today I check routes. People aren't switches.”
„Wer alles rein nennt, hat meist nur den: “Whoever calls everything pure has usually just forgotten the drain. My cauldron had one too, once.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“Whoever calls everything pure has usually just forgotten the drain. My cauldron had one too, once.” “The test is called The Clean Residue Test. You'll find it at the Roundhouse Depot. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
„Zeit hält keine Versprechen. Du kannst: “Time keeps no promises. But you can stop charging it to others as debt.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“Time keeps no promises. But you can stop charging it to others as debt.” “The test is called The Pause in the Escape Wheel. You'll find it at the Signal Slope. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
„Zuhören macht dich nicht zum Erben eine: “Listening doesn't make you heir to a throat. Even the dead may leave a sentence unfinished.” Find both leads and choose between an open counter-test and a fight.

“Listening doesn't make you heir to a throat. Even the dead may leave a sentence unfinished.” “The test is called The Sentence That May Be Missing. You'll find it at the Sound Test House. Read both leads before you face the guardian.”
